svg.title: Companion papers
svg.desc: The main paper, Ismail's Primitives V6.2, sits at the centre. Four companion papers apply the same six primitives under a fixed relabelling: Economic Adaptation Theory, Human Development, Emotional Adaptation Theory, and the SPEA Protocol, which operationalises the emotional-adaptation paper.
